clinical-note-summarizer.description: Standard adult routine checkup and prophylaxis

variables.transcript: Patient came in for regular 6-month checkup. No acute pain reported. Gingival margins slightly inflamed in lower anterior region. Performed full mouth scaling and polishing. Patient advised on daily flossing technique. Recare scheduled for 6 months.

Doctor: Patient complains of food packing upper right first molar tooth 16. Exam shows primary dentinal caries on occlusal surface. Administered 1 carpule 2% lidocaine with 1:100k epi. Excavated caries, etched, bonded, restored with microhybrid composite shade A2. Occlusion checked with articulating paper, high spots relieved. Post-op instructions given.

clinical-note-summarizer.description: Emergency acute pulpitis and endodontic access

variables.transcript: Doctor: Severe lingering nocturnal throbbing pain in lower left molar tooth 36. Cold test positive with severe prolonged response. Tender to vertical percussion. Diagnosis irreversible pulpitis. Infiltrated 4% articaine. Rubber dam isolated. Access cavity prepared, located 3 canals (MB, ML, Distal). Extirpated pulp, irrigated with 2.5% NaOCl, working lengths confirmed with apex locator. Placed calcium hydroxide inter-appointment dressing and Cavit temporary. Rx Ibuprofen 400mg TDS for 3 days.

clinical-note-summarizer.description: Pediatric mixed dentition stainless steel crown

variables.transcript: 6 year old patient brought by mother. Large distal caries on primary second molar 75. Periapical radiograph shows sound roots with no furcation involvement. Indicated for pulpotomy and stainless steel crown. Ferric sulfate 15.5% applied for 15 seconds, ZOE base, preformed SSC size 4 crimped and cemented with GIC. Child tolerated procedure well with Tell-Show-Do.

clinical-note-summarizer.description: Surgical exodontia of impacted third molar FDI 48

variables.transcript: Patient presents with recurrent pericoronitis lower right quadrant. OPG shows mesioangular impacted wisdom tooth 48. Signed informed consent obtained. Inferior alveolar nerve block administered with 2% mepivacaine. Envelope flap raised, buccal bone guttering performed under sterile saline irrigation. Tooth sectioned crown-root. Retrieved with straight elevator. Socket debrided, 3-0 silk suture placed. Pressure pack applied for 30 minutes. Rx Amoxicillin 500mg TDS 5 days, Paracetamol 1g QDS prn. Suture removal in 7 days.

Comprehensive restoration appointment. Tooth 14 MO composite, Tooth 15 DO composite, and Tooth 26 Palatal pit composite. All prepared under rubber dam isolation. Selective enamel etch, universal bond, composite cured in 2mm increments. Polished with Sof-Lex discs. All contacts tight with dental floss.
